annotations.title: Buy a full report from the agent's wallet

description: For a projection that buy_projection paid for, once check_projection shows it done: returns the payment link for its full report, $10, paid from the agent's MPP wallet with a Stripe Shared Payment Token. The full report is a PDF with each candidate's standing in each topic group of campaign activities, each campaign's frame, a win strategy for each candidate, the 51% line, and the sources. The paid answer starts the report; check_projection then gives its state and, once it is done, the link to its PDF. A report that fails refunds its payment. Needs no sign-in.

run_id.description: The run_id of the projection that buy_projection paid for.
